photos.title: Carolina Forest from above
photos.what: Part of Carolina Forest from the air (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): curving streets of houses around lakes, Carolina Forest Boulevard across the middle, a four-lane highway below it and the Intracoastal Waterway at the lower right.
photos.caption: Part of Carolina Forest from the air, in 2023. Newer streets are not on it.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Carolina Forest: curving streets of houses around lakes and pine woods, with a wide road across the middle and the Intracoastal Waterway at the lower right
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-17; request in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty exported this view from the NAIP service; nothing drawn on it
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-17. Streets, lakes, woods and roads only. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
